app.name: Mangosteen Campus
app.tagline: The online learning system for your courses

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your student/staff ID or your email
login.taglineSub: View lessons, take quizzes, submit work and follow your scores in one place
login.resendWait: You can send it again in {{seconds}} s
login.verificationSent: If this email isn't verified yet, we've sent you a link

register.tagline: Sign up with email and start learning right after you verify
register.taglineSub: Any email domain is welcome. Teacher accounts are created by administrators only
register.title: Sign up
register.subtitle: Accounts you create yourself are student accounts
register.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, and not an easy-to-guess password

checkInbox.title: Check your email
checkInbox.body: We sent a verification link to <email>{{email}}</email>. The link works for 24 hours
checkInbox.resendWait: You can send again in {{seconds}} s
checkInbox.resent: If you haven't verified yet, we've sent a new link. The previous link no longer works

verifyEmail.successBody: Your account is ready. Sign in to see your courses
verifyEmail.invalidBody: Links expire and work only once. Enter your email to get a new one
verifyEmail.sendWait: You can send again in {{seconds}} s
verifyEmail.sent: If this email signed up and isn't verified yet, we've sent a new link

invalid_credentials.title: The sign-in details are incorrect
invalid_credentials.description: Check your ID or email and your password, then try again.

email_not_verified.title: This account's email isn't verified yet
email_not_verified.description: Open the link in the email we sent to get started.

validation_error.title: Some details are missing
validation_error.description: Enter both your ID or email and your password.

network_error.title: Can't reach the system
network_error.description: Check your internet connection and try again.

fieldErrors.invalid: This isn't in the right format
fieldErrors.email_taken: An account with this email already exists
fieldErrors.password_too_short: The password is too short. Use at least 8 characters
fieldErrors.password_too_common: This password is too easy to guess
fieldErrors.password_entirely_numeric: The password can't be only numbers
fieldErrors.password_too_similar: The password is too similar to your name or email
